∀ (ids : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId), Minidregg.Kernel.DurableEngine.nodupFast ids = Bool.true ↔ ids.Nodup

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (records : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes), Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.replay rootBytes before records = Option.some after → after.model.history = (List.map (fun r => (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase r).event) records).reverse ++ before.model.history

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (records : List Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord) (before after : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes), Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.replay rootBytes before records = Option.some after → after.model.journal = (List.map (fun r => (r.transactionId, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase r)) records).reverse ++ before.model.journal ∧ ∀ (n : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier), after.model.consumed n = (Decidable.decide (n ∈ List.flatMap Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord.nullifiers records) || before.model.consumed n)

Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.resume = Minidregg.Kernel.DurableEngine.resumeFast

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image} {bh : ℕ} {st : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.resume rootBytes image bh st = Option.some snap → snap.model.history = (List.map (fun r => (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase r).event) image.accepted).reverse

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image} {bh : ℕ} {st : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.resume rootBytes image bh st = Option.some snap → snap.model.journal = (List.map (fun r => (r.transactionId, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase r)) image.accepted).reverse ∧ ∀ (n : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier), snap.model.consumed n = (Decidable.decide (n ∈ List.flatMap Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord.nullifiers (List.drop bh image.accepted)) || Decidable.decide (n ∈ List.flatMap Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.IntentRecord.nullifiers (List.take bh image.accepted)))

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image} {height : ℕ} {state : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State} {engine : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableEngine.Engine}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableEngine.resumeEngine rootBytes image height state = Option.some engine → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.resume rootBytes image height state = Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableEngine.Engine.view rootBytes engine)

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {image : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableReceiver.Image} {bh : ℕ} {st : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State} {snap : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.resume rootBytes image bh st = Option.some snap → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.resume rootBytes image image.accepted.length (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.State.ofSnapshot image snap) = Option.some snap
